# Simple Rabbit

> Simple Rabbit is a one-person web design studio based in Bergen County, New Jersey, founded in 2023 by Leann Frank. The studio builds custom WordPress websites for private-pay women's wellness practices in the United States, including practices in functional and integrative medicine, women's hormone and menopause care, holistic gynecology, and aesthetics and laser. Every website is custom-built (no templates), includes ongoing care plans (hosting, security, updates, content changes), and is designed to rank on Google for the local searches the practice's patients run. Pricing starts at $4,800 for the website build.
